answer: A farm of 282 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in vertex, queued in umber, and island publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 70 identities per epoch. A farm of 846 identities would post 1048 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
